verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents its own ways to test in isolation: the docs recommend testing with isolated per-test namespaces, and 'branch from namespace' instantly creates a copy-on-write clone, so tests can run against realistic data without modifying the production namespace. Server-side namespace copies add another way to stage test data. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated sandbox or test-mode environment; isolation happens at the namespace level inside the same account. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment or test-mode credentials, documented credential scoping that keeps test tokens away from production namespaces, in-depth testing docs beyond a one-line mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
